_note: Mollosar's Journal — lore notes. A note appears when its unlock_flag is set (empty flag = always unlocked). Story bot: add notes here.

notes.body: A worn journal, given to you by Grimley after the Snaplings. 'Write it down,' he said. 'The underworld forgets. You don't have to.' This is your quest log, your creature ledger, your memory against the erasure.
notes.title: Grimley's Gift

notes.body: The economy is souls. Soul Credits are the currency — earned from bounties, trainer victories, and the Night Market's patient arithmetic. Spend them at stalls and shops. The Ledger takes its cut and pretends not to notice the rest.
notes.title: Soul Credits

notes.body: Small shrines with a hanging lantern, found across the underworld. Rest at one: your progress is saved, your vigor restored, your party healed. The light steadies you. The Ledger doesn't watch here.
notes.title: Lantern Shrines

notes.body: Tall patches of soul-flame grass shimmer where wild creatures roam. Walk through and something may find you. Weaken it, throw a Soul Snare, and it might come with you. Bosses and trainers' creatures can't be caught — some things aren't yours to take.
notes.title: Wild Encounters

notes.body: The Soul Council's bounty board tracks every hunter's tally — yours and Wrath's. He takes the contracts you pass up, and he remembers. The Kanryu bounty sits at the top, sealed. Fifty thousand credits and a vault item. Not for you. That's the point.
notes.title: The Bounty Board

notes.body: A blue-winged messenger delivered the Council's terms at Murray's Bar. Kanryu — alive, and worth more than anything you've ever been offered. The terms will change at the Act's seam. They always do.
notes.title: The Kanryu Announcement
